description: The only external MCP dependency Cosmo has. Reads (and optionally writes) frames, components, variables, and styles from a Figma library file. Cosmo prompts the user to connect this at session start (§ A.Startup handshake in cosmo.system-prompt.md).

figma-developer-mcp.notes: Community read-focused MCP. Good for design ingestion and audits; may not support all write operations.

custom.notes: Replace with your Figma MCP binary of choice. Cosmo works with any stdio-transport MCP that exposes get_file / get_components / get_variables / get_styles.

notes: This file is documentation of what Cosmo expects. The runtime config lives in runtime/node/.env — not here.
Never commit a real FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN. Use env vars.
